subtitle: Lesson 11 · Cloud Encryption: At Rest and In Transit

code:
Platform-managed key

  Setup:     none — on by default
  Generated: by the provider
  Rotation:  provider's own schedule
  Revoke:    you can't
caption: What's already protecting your Storage Account or S3 bucket, with zero work.

code:
Customer-managed key

  Setup:     you create it in Key Vault / KMS
  Generated: by you
  Rotation:  your schedule, your audit log
  Revoke:    you decide, anytime
caption: Real, demonstrable control the provider never had on its own.

eyebrow: The real risk of a CMK
code:
Delete or lose the CMK
   -> data becomes permanently unreadable
   -> no recovery path, by design

Done on purpose, this is called
"crypto-shredding."
caption: Real control comes with real operational responsibility.
